text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the academy is holding an event
for
children to experience what it's like
to be
enrolled at the school. Yaeno
Muteki has been
assigned a group of
children to guide.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look! You can see the whole track from
here! And
there's people running! One,
two, three...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Just full of energy, aren't we? ♪
Be
careful not to lean out too far—it's
dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If anyone wants a better look, I'll hoist
you onto
my shoulders! Just raise your
hand if you'd like a
lift!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... I can't figure it out! How do I
close the
gap between us?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's beyond me! I just don't know how to
address
the children! Compared to those
two, I'm horribly
awkward... And on top
of that—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mimi. Do you think I'll be able to
see my
house if I get a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: We're not getting piggyback rides, we're getting shoulder rides!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I want to keep them safe! But
being
overprotective would disrupt the
orientation and
impede their
independence!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now that you mention it, I used to
train my
younger brother. Maybe I could
adopt the same
approach with these
children!
choice_data_list: 道場で子どもを相手にした経験は？
choice_data_list_en: Do you have any experience working with kids at the dojo?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Squad, fall in! Bow to, er, bow
before the
Three Goddesses! Now bow
to your
mast—anyway, bow to me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You there! Bow properly! Put some spirit
into it!
Spirit!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's... kinda scary...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now I've done it! When I talk to them
like they're
my little brother, my true
nature slips out! This is
only going to
make things worse!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I think a more casual approach
might
suffice. Just be yourself. Treat the
children as you
would anyone else, and
I'm sure they'll take to
you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But I'm really not confident I can do it.
I'm so
unrefined... What if I end up
scaring them?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Shiho's not here... Where'd she
go?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. There's a child missing from
Yaeno
Muteki's group. I'm pretty sure
the girl was here a
moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is!

text_block_list.name: Extremely Curious Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... They're amazing. Everyone's so
fast...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see the child mesmerized by the
students
running on the track, wandering
dangerously
close to it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oh no! Somebody could hit her!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I need to help her right away... but will I
make it
in time?! Yaeno, you fool! You
should have been
paying more
attention!)
(Yaeno! Do not hesitate!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong your opponent or
how dire
the situation, remember that
retreat is a fool's
errand. Fear leads only
to failure. Overcome it,
lest your path
remain forever closed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Should doubt form in your heart, there is
only one
answer. Take pride in yourself,
determine the
path you must take, and
do what needs to be
done!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Yes! Right now, I must pour my heart
and soul
into doing one thing and one
thing only!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what did I do?

text_block_list.name: Extremely Curious Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That was... amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaeno! What was that just now?! Where did that speed come from? I couldn't believe my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You shot forward in the blink of an eye
and
scooped the child right off the
track!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: You were sooo awesome! That was the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see... I did what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see... I did what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I remembered Grandfather's words—the
Yaegaki
teachings passed down through
generations of
warriors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head high as a protector of
the people.
When facing crisis, neither
hesitate nor
speak—simply do what is
right.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The teachings that live in my body
compelled it
to move of its own accord.
Yes... That is what I
believe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have stumbled for a moment,
but Yaeno
Muteki prevails of her own
strength and grows
more confident in
the process. The orientation
goes on to
conclude without further incident.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Kon...go yaigocky style?! If I study that,
can I
become as strong as you?! I wanna
learn it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I warn you... Kongo Yaegaki training is
extremely
rigorous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about giving them a
glimpse of
what it's like? Everyone
seems so excited! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Very well. Let's try once again...
Fall in
line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki takes on the role of
mentor to the
children, and the
orientation comes to a close
with her
having earned their respect.
